environmentVariables.name: PAX8_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 audience claim requested when minting the Pax8 token. The default is the partner API audience; change it only if Pax8 told you to.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Pax8 API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pax8 Partner API OAuth2 Client ID (Pax8 portal > Integrations).

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Pax8 Partner API OAuth2 Client Secret (Pax8 portal > Integrations).

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional OAuth2 scope; omitted from the token request when unset.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default: the client ID and secret go only to Pax8's token manager, and a URL on any other host is refused before anything is sent.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Pax8 requests.

environmentVariables.name: PAX8_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
